memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Vitamin B12 deficiency
  - Status: New diagnosis, symptomatic fatigue
  - Plan: Start methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD, check B12 in 8 weeks
- Benign positional vertigo
  - Status: Episodes on positional change, Dix-Hallpike pending
  - Plan: Start betahistine 16 mg BD, meclizine 25 mg SOS, arrange Dix-Hallpike
- Non‑alcoholic fatty liver disease
  - Status: Asymptomatic, obesity (weight 78 kg, waist 92 cm >90 cm cut‑off)
  - Plan: Start silymarin 140 mg TDS, rosuvastatin 5 mg OD, lifestyle advice
- Diet advice: Breakfast – high‑protein, low‑carb; Lunch – mixed veg with dal; Dinner – light, early
- Weight: 78 kg, Waist: 92 cm (above male cut‑off)
- Due: HbA1c repeat 2025-07-05

memories.author: lab

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Vitamin B12 deficiency
  - Status: Improved energy, B12 rising
  - Plan: Continue methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD, repeat B12 in 3 months
- Benign positional vertigo
  - Status: Episodes reduced to twice weekly
  - Plan: Continue betahistine 16 mg BD, keep meclizine SOS, repeat Dix-Hallpike if worsening
- Non‑alcoholic fatty liver disease
  - Status: Weight stable 78 kg, waist 90 cm (at cut‑off)
  - Plan: Continue silymarin 140 mg TDS, rosuvastatin 5 mg OD, repeat LFT and lipid profile
- Diet advice: Breakfast – egg whites & fruit; Lunch – quinoa salad; Dinner – grilled fish & veg
- Weight: 78 kg, Waist: 90 cm
- Due: HbA1c repeat 2025-10-10

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Appointment booked for 2025-10-05 10:30 with Dr Karthik Hegde (D04) for routine follow‑up.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Vitamin B12 deficiency
  - Status: B12 satisfactory, no fatigue
  - Plan: Continue methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD, check B12 Jan 2026
- Benign positional vertigo
  - Status: Vertigo rare, only with rapid head turn
  - Plan: Continue betahistine 16 mg BD, meclizine SOS, consider vestibular rehab if worsens
- Non‑alcoholic fatty liver disease
  - Status: Weight 77 kg, waist 88 cm (<90 cm)
  - Plan: Continue silymarin 140 mg TDS, rosuvastatin 10 mg OD, repeat LFT & lipid Apr 2026
- Diet advice: Breakfast – oats & nuts; Lunch – brown rice & legumes; Dinner – soup & steamed veg
- Weight: 77 kg, Waist: 88 cm
- Due: HbA1c repeat 2026-01-05

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Abdominal ultrasound: Liver shows grade 1 steatosis, spleen normal, no focal lesion. Portal vein patent.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Refer to Dr S. Rao, Gastroenterology, Apollo Hospital Bengaluru, for NAFLD fibrosis assessment (Fibroscan) and dietary guidance.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Gastroenterology report: Fibroscan shows CAP 240 dB/m (steatosis), stiffness 6.2 kPa (F0‑F1). Advised continue lifestyle, repeat in 6 months.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Feeling well, vertigo almost gone, occasional mild dizziness when standing fast. Energy good, no new symptoms.
